title: GapReport
description: What the run could not close: unmet criteria, unverified load-bearing premises, and the next cheapest test. Single writer: Librarian (Close). Append-only; a correction is a new record referencing this one.

id.description: Record id: a lower-case type prefix, a hyphen, at least three digits. Unique within a run.

best_candidate_id.description: The best candidate found, or null if nothing beat B0.

unmet_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria not met, verbatim from the FrameRecord.

unverified_load_bearing.description: PremiseRecords the best answer depends on that remain unverified.

next_cheapest_test.description: The one measurement most worth paying for next.

termination.description: Why the run stopped without meeting acceptance.
